prompts.walk: Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset: one Zhongli horizontal fighting-game walk sprite with real alpha. Image 1 is the EDIT TARGET, the existing walk pose. Image 2 is an IDENTITY reference only, not a pose to copy. Fix only the cramped canvas framing: preserve Image 1's full walking pose, face, hair, brown/gold coat, hands, both legs, complete boot toes and heels. Keep the same head-to-torso and limb proportions. Expand the transparent canvas on ALL sides, particularly right and bottom; fit the entire original figure inside with at least 10% CLEAR transparent margin on every edge, so it occupies at most 80% of canvas width and height. No part may touch an edge. Preserve the original character artwork as closely as possible, with no nonuniform stretching. Do not cut off or alter the left trailing hair or coat tails. Single complete full-body side/three-quarter sprite facing right. Match the crisp cel-shaded reference artwork; no pixelation conversion in this step. REAL fully transparent alpha background, no brown haze, no outline halo, NO ground shadow, no glow, sparkle, particles, floor, text or extra objects. The only intended change is transparent framing, not a new walk pose.
prompts.recovery: Use case: identity-preserve / precise-object-edit. Asset: ONE full-body Zhongli recovery transition sprite for a side-view fighting game. Image 1 is the previous recovery pose to continue. Image 2 is the EXISTING armed ready pose that this transition will return to; preserve that spear design, hands, anatomy and costume. Image 3 is the character identity reference only. Draw a single intermediate recovery pose: after the thrust, torso rises slightly out of the lunge, weight shifts back onto the rear support leg, the forward foot draws inward approximately one half of the difference between image1 and image2, knees remain anatomically connected, hips and shoulders unwind together. The rear hand holds the same shaft near the rear of the grip; the front hand relaxes toward the hip while retaining a correct wrapped grip. The spear remains whole, angled down-right exactly as in the armed ready reference, with coherent unchanged length, a straight continuous dark shaft and complete gold spearhead. This should smoothly connect image1 to image2, not become the empty-handed idle. Keep the head/neck/pelvis/hip/knee/ankle proportions and brown/gold coat design; only adjust the recovery posture and boot placement. Two arms/two hands/two legs, readable wrapped fingers, no disconnected knees. Keep character, both boots, hair, all coat tails and the entire spear wholly within the canvas with at least 8% transparent padding on ALL sides. Remove neighboring-pose fragments from the source crop: no stray gold strips at the top, no additional spear, no extra objects. Same crisp cel-shaded source style; do not perform pixel-art fitting yet. REAL alpha transparency, no shadow, halo, amber haze, glow, sparkle, motion streak, energy effect, floor, text or watermark. One isolated pose, not a sprite sheet.
